files_examined: patch_manager_mods/hud_host_src/kotor2-steam-aspyr.hooks.toml (existence and handler names only, via Glob/Grep)

findings.evidence: HH_LayoutClosing checks `if (!hhd::isHudPanel(vtbl, uint32_t(gameaddr::HudVtable))) return;` (line 136). GameAddr.h:2-3 states every constant in gameaddr is the STEAM Aspyr column, and line 72 defines `HudVtable = 0x0099DCC4`. GameAddr.h:3-6 says code that must also run on GOG should read names from k2addr::get(), and kGog is unfilled (all zero). The GOG hooks file (kotor2-gog-aspyr.hooks.toml:55-57) enables the same handler at a different GOG address (0x0090DA20 vs Steam 0x0040F5A0), so the GOG panel vtable read at line 135 is compared against the Steam HUD vtable constant.
findings.suggested_investigation: Confirm the GOG value of the CSWGuiInGame RTTI vtable (Ghidra database k2_win_gog_aspyr_swkotor2.exe, or the vtable pointer stored at the HUD panel in a GOG run). Check whether k2addr::get() / K2AddrTable exposes a HudVtable field and whether it is populated for GOG. Check that hhd::isHudPanel is a plain equality test. Then confirm by logging the panel vtable on a GOG build: the 'first BUILD dispatch' KP_LOG at line 142 should appear if the test passes. Do not run this against the live install; use a scratch copy.
findings.why_it_matters: On GOG the HUD-vtable test will almost certainly never match, so K2HUD_BUILD is silently never dispatched. Consumers such as combat-hotbar that create labels at BUILD would never run on GOG. The manifest (manifest.toml:13-16) now advertises kotor2_gog_aspyr as supported, and the early return at line 136 gives no log line, so the failure is invisible in normal play.

notes: Hook byte windows check out. original_bytes are whole instructions: 55 8B EC 83 EC 38 and 55 8B EC 83 EC 10 are push/mov/sub; 5E 8B E5 5D C2 0C 00 is pop/mov/pop/ret 0xC, 7 bytes. None contains a relative branch. Addresses match the comments: 0x514B40=5327680, 0x514E47=5328455, 0x90DA20=9493024. The Steam and GOG hooks files name the same three handlers, and exports.def exports all three, each defined in HudHostProvider.cpp at lines 87, 107 and 131. The target_versions hash matches manifest.toml:16.
